title: "Figure 4 – Collecting Duct cell analysis across timepoints"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-06-01"
output: html_document
description: >
  (B) UMAP of CD subsets (ICA, ICB, PC, DegCD).
  (C) Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi).
  (D) DotPlot of canonical CD subset markers.
  (E) UMAPs of CD cells split by timepoint.
  (G) Spatial feature plots of representative CD markers (Atp6v1g3, Slc4a1, Slc26a4, Aqp2) across timepoints.
  (H–I) DotPlots of subset-by-timepoint expression for additional CD markers.
  (J) PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints.
  (K) DotPlot of AMP gene expression across CD subsets and timepoints.
  (L) GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for each CD subset.

  Spatial:     Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_with_PROGENyCandidatePath_v05292026.rds

Output: Results/Figures/Figure4/

## Load data

```{r load-data}
# Single-cell CD object (ICA / ICB / PC / DegCD annotated)
CDcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "ICPCcells_DegCD_v02142025.RDS"))
CDcells <- UpdateSeuratObject(CDcells)

# Ordered CD subset levels
subset_order    <- c("ICA", "ICB", "PC", "DegCD")
timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")

# Set identity to CD subset annotation
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)

cat("CD subset counts:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet))
```

## Shared setup

```{r shared-setup}
# Combined subset × timepoint identity (used in H, I, J, K)
CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint <- paste(
  CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot,
  CDcells@meta.data$DataSet,
  sep = "_"
)

combined_order <- paste(
  rep(subset_order, each = length(timepoint_order)),
  timepoint_order,
  sep = "_"
)
combined_order <- combined_order[combined_order %in% unique(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint)]

# Canonical CD marker gene sets
ICA_markers  <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Aqp6", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a7", "Kit")
ICB_markers  <- c("Slc26a4", "Spink8", "Hmx2")
PC_markers   <- c("Aqp2", "Hsd11b2", "Scnn1g", "Syt7")
canonical_cd <- c(ICA_markers, ICB_markers, PC_markers)
```

## Figure 4C: Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints

```{r fig4c-proportion, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
prop_df <- table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet, CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = subset_order)
  )

Fig4C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Subset)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "CD subset proportions across timepoints") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4C_CD_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4C_Prop,
  width    = 4, height = 4
)
Fig4C_Prop
```

## Figure 4G: Spatial feature plots of representative CD markers across timepoints

```{r fig4g-spatial-features, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
spatial_cd_markers <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a4", "Aqp2")
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

for (m in spatial_cd_markers) {
  skip_to_next <- FALSE
  tryCatch(
    print(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]),
    error = function(e) { skip_to_next <<- TRUE }
  )
  if (skip_to_next) next

  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))
  Minvalue <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))

  CDMarkerSpatialFeature <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = m,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = myPalette(4),
      limits  = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4G_Spatial_", m, "_CDMarker.pdf"),
    plot     = CDMarkerSpatialFeature,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 15
  )
}
```

## Figure 4J: PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints

```{r fig4j-progeny, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint, levels = combined_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# Run PROGENy via decoupleR MLM
net_cd  <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "mouse", top = 500)
mat_cd  <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))

acts_cd <- run_mlm(
  mat     = mat_cd,
  net     = net_cd,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "weight",
  minsize = 5
)

CDcells[["pathwaysmlm_cd"]] <- acts_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "pathwaysmlm_cd"
CDcells <- ScaleData(CDcells)

# Average scaled activity per subset × timepoint
df_cd <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "pathwaysmlm_cd", layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(group = Idents(CDcells)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -group, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(group, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

cd_acts_mat <- df_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "group", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("group") %>%
  as.matrix()

PathwayOrder_cd <- c(
  "NFkB", "TNFa", "Hypoxia", "JAK-STAT",
  "Trail", "p53",
  "MAPK", "EGFR", "PI3K", "VEGF",
  "TGFb", "WNT", "Estrogen"
)
PathwayOrder_cd <- PathwayOrder_cd[PathwayOrder_cd %in% colnames(cd_acts_mat)]
groups_present  <- combined_order[combined_order %in% rownames(cd_acts_mat)]

CDHeatmapMat <- t(cd_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder_cd, groups_present]

palette_length <- 100
cd_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
cd_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 1, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig4J_Progeny <- pheatmap(
  CDHeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 7,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = cd_color,
  breaks         = cd_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy pathway activity – CD subsets × timepoints",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4J_CD_PROGENy_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
print(Fig4J_Progeny)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 4L: GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for each CD subset

```{r fig4l-go-enrichment, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

AllMarkers_cd <- FindAllMarkers(
  CDcells,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  #logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "MAST",
  only.pos        = TRUE
)

write.csv( 
  AllMarkers_cd,
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
saveRDS(
  AllMarkers_cd,
  file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_DEGs.rds")
)
ClusterGenes_cd <- list(
  ICA   = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "ICA",   p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  ICB   = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "ICB",   p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  PC    = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "PC",    p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene),
  DegCD = AllMarkers_cd %>% filter(cluster == "DegCD", p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>% pull(gene)
)
# Remove empty groups
ClusterGenes_cd <- ClusterGenes_cd[sapply(ClusterGenes_cd, length) > 0]

GO_cd <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = ClusterGenes_cd,
  fun          = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb        = "org.Mm.eg.db",
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  pvalueCutoff = 1
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(GO_cd),
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected_go_cd <- c("lipid oxidation","organic acid catabolic process","carboxylic acid catabolic process","monocarboxylic acid catabolic process","fatty acid catabolic process","fatty acid oxidation","fatty acid metabolic process","fatty acid beta-oxidation","lipid catabolic process","regulation of inflammatory response","chemokine production","phagocytosis","neutrophil activation","macrophage chemotaxis","granulocyte migration","Fc receptor mediated stimulatory signaling pathway","insulin receptor signaling pathway","leukocyte cell−cell adhesion","fibroblast migration","fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway","regulation of fibroblast proliferation","cellular respiration","response to hypoxia","NADP metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide catabolic process","reactive oxygen species metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide metabolic process","generation of precursor metabolites and energy","fatty acid metabolic process","organic acid catabolic process","carboxylic acid catabolic process","regulation of cellular pH","intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway","collecting duct development"
)

Fig4L_GO <- dotplot(
  GO_cd,
  showCategory = selected_go_cd,
  font.size    = 9,
  label_format = 60,
  by           = "geneRatio"
) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process – CD subset DEGs") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4L_CD_GO_Dotplot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4L_GO,
  width    = 10, height = 5
)
Fig4L_GO
```

## Figure 4M: CytoTRACE differentiation state analysis

```{r fig4m-cytotrace, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# CytoTRACE scores transcriptional diversity per cell as a proxy for
# differentiation state: score ~1 = stem-like/undifferentiated, ~0 = fully differentiated
library(CytoTRACE)

Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# CytoTRACE expects a genes × cells raw count matrix
ct_mat     <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
ct_results <- CytoTRACE(ct_mat)

# Add score to metadata (align by cell barcode)
CDcells$CytoTRACE_score <- ct_results$CytoTRACE[colnames(CDcells)]

# Panel M1: UMAP colored by CytoTRACE score
Fig4M_UMAP <- FeaturePlot(
  CDcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  pt.size  = 0.4,
  cols     = rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))
) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE differentiation score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4M_CD_CytoTRACE_UMAP.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4M_UMAP,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)

# Panel M2: Violin plot of CytoTRACE score per CD subset
Fig4M_Vln_Subset <- VlnPlot(
  CDcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  pt.size  = 0,
  cols     = brewer.pal(max(4, length(subset_order)), "Set2")[seq_along(subset_order)]
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE score by CD subset", x = "Subset", y = "CytoTRACE score") +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4M_CD_CytoTRACE_VlnSubset.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4M_Vln_Subset,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)

# Panel M3: Violin plot of CytoTRACE score per timepoint
CDcells$DataSet <- factor(CDcells$DataSet, levels = timepoint_order)
Fig4M_Vln_Time <- VlnPlot(
  CDcells,
  features = "CytoTRACE_score",
  group.by = "DataSet",
  pt.size  = 0,
  cols     = brewer.pal(4, "Blues")
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE score by timepoint", x = "Timepoint", y = "CytoTRACE score") +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4M_CD_CytoTRACE_VlnTimepoint.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4M_Vln_Time,
  width    = 4, height = 4
)

Fig4M <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig4M_UMAP, Fig4M_Vln_Subset, Fig4M_Vln_Time,
                             nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.2, 1, 0.8))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4M_CD_CytoTRACE_Combined.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4M,
  width    = 12, height = 4
)
Fig4M
```

## Figure 4N: Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory of CD cells

```{r fig4n-monocle3-pseudotime, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# Convert Seurat → Monocle3 CellDataSet (reuses Seurat UMAP embedding)
cds_cd <- as.cell_data_set(CDcells)

# Re-use the existing Seurat UMAP so trajectory overlays the same layout
cds_cd@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- Embeddings(CDcells, "umap")[colnames(cds_cd), ]

# Cluster cells and learn trajectory graph across all CD subsets
cds_cd <- cluster_cells(cds_cd, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds_cd <- learn_graph(cds_cd, use_partition = FALSE)

# Root trajectory at PC cells at 0DPI (most differentiated, homeostatic CD state)
get_cd_root_nodes <- function(cds_obj) {
  origin_cell_ids <- which(
    colData(cds_obj)$DataSet    == "0DPI" &
    colData(cds_obj)$ICPCAnnot %in% c("PC", "ICA")
  )
  closest_vertex <- cds_obj@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds_obj), ])
  root_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds_obj)[["UMAP"]])$name[
    as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[origin_cell_ids, ]))))
  ]
  root_nodes
}
cds_cd <- order_cells(cds_cd, root_pr_nodes = get_cd_root_nodes(cds_cd))

# Store pseudotime in Seurat metadata for downstream plotting
CDcells$Pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds_cd)[colnames(CDcells)]

# Panel N1: UMAP colored by CD subset with trajectory graph
Fig4N_Subset <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "ICPCAnnot",
  label_cell_groups   = TRUE,
  label_leaves        = TRUE,
  label_branch_points = TRUE,
  graph_label_size    = 1.5,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "CD trajectory – subset") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel N2: UMAP colored by pseudotime
Fig4N_Pseudo <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "pseudotime",
  label_cell_groups   = FALSE,
  label_leaves        = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "CD trajectory – pseudotime") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel N3: UMAP colored by timepoint
Fig4N_Time <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "DataSet",
  label_cell_groups   = FALSE,
  label_leaves        = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "CD trajectory – timepoint") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

Fig4N <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig4N_Subset, Fig4N_Pseudo, Fig4N_Time, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4N_CD_Monocle3_Pseudotime.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4N,
  width    = 14, height = 4
)
Fig4N
```
